pages.lesson:
LESSON: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports
Topic 1.2: Components of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Components of Creative Arts and Sports. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How does one create harmony pictorial composition?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the elements of a play
2. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness
3. name pitches on the grand stave

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the elements of a play
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the elements of a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness
   In simple words: practise until you can perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. name pitches on the grand stave
   In simple words: practise until you can name pitches on the grand stave. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Components of Creative Arts and Sports using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Components of Creative Arts and Sports in the examples.
2. Explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
4. Show that you can: describe the elements of a play

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Components of Creative Arts and Sports using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Components of Creative Arts and Sports important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Watch actual or virtual play performance to identify the elements of a play,
2. Discuss the basic elements of a play
3. Practise activities that enhance power and reaction time using music,
4. Draw the grand stave and name lines and spaces,
5. Draw the piano keyboard and relate to the grand stave,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does one create harmony pictorial composition?
2. Why should athletes avoid performance enhancers to develop physical fitness?
3. Why is note extension important in music notation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the elements of a play
2. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness
3. name pitches on the grand stave

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
